entries.06abe8192d37b87e: It is a company visit app. Placing importance on matching based on vision and values, it supports the early stages of recruitment activities. For companies, it provides a subscription-based recruitment service through which they can use job postings, article submissions, sending and receiving messages with candidates, and scouting (direct recruiting), and it also provides optional services such as advertising and content creation. This is a service closely related to revenue generation. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.

entries.5ebd56fbf57a0985: Under the mission "increasing the number of people whose hearts dance at work through the ultimate right person in the right place," it operates the business SNS "Wantedly" as a platform for all businesspeople. Aiming to enhance corporate value over the medium to long term, its policy is to, while continuously developing and improving its mainstay product "Wantedly Visit," actively promote "Engagement Suite" and "Wantedly Hire" in a new business area. As priority matters, it cites strengthening the value provided by the Visit business through improvement of the recommendation algorithm and other means and accelerating investment in new business areas, and shows a policy of investing the earnings of "Wantedly Visit" in "Engagement Suite" and "Wantedly Hire" and fostering them into businesses that drive growth over the medium to long term. As issues to be addressed, it cites expanding earnings opportunities through the use of AI, ensuring system stability, strengthening the business organization system, strengthening the information management system, and raising awareness of its services.

entries.b951f8faaf41c39e: This is a single-segment business operating Wantedly, a business SNS for all business professionals. By creating and expanding business connections from perspectives that conventional mechanisms have overlooked, such as vision, individuality and values, it supports individuals' careers from meeting others through to settling in and performing well. As of the end of August 2025, the domestic service had 4.32 million individual users and 43,000 corporate users. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥4,908 million.
entries.c76e53468da8bc6c: It is a next-generation recruitment management system (ATS). It supports centralized management and streamlining of the entire selection process from application to job offer, and provides functions such as automatic scheduling, flexible process design, and advanced data analysis. This is a service in a new business area, released in November 2024. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.

entries.e0439990282c79eb: A feature is its mechanism of matching individuals and companies not through conditions such as salary and benefits but through sympathy with the company's vision and values. It is structured so that job postings and articles issued by companies being shared on social media by employees and individual users leads to the registration of new individual users and the opening of accounts by companies. Fees are subscription-type, premised on continuous service provision, and because it is a form used by many customers at relatively low unit prices, the top 10 companies by sales account for 10% or less of total sales, in a structure with little dependence on specific customers.
